known_facts_book1: The girlish Ruler of the Land of Oz, no older or larger than Dorothy, clothed in silver gauze and wearing a jeweled diadem.
Drives a golden chariot drawn by the Cowardly Lion and the Hungry Tiger, and carries an ivory wand tipped with diamond letters 'O' and 'Z'.
Was, as a baby, stolen by a wicked old witch and transformed into a boy, and did not know she was a girl until restored by a kind sorceress; she is the only child of the former Ruler of Oz.
Learns from Glinda the Good, who gives her a magic carpet that unrolls itself, allowing her army to cross the deadly desert.
Crosses the desert with an army of twenty-seven soldiers to free Dorothy and to rescue the royal family of Ev.
Compels Princess Langwidere to release Dorothy from the tower.
Leads the expedition to the Nome King's palace and demands he free the Queen of Ev and her children.
Takes the guessing challenge first, makes eleven wrong guesses, and is transformed into an emerald grasshopper.
Is restored by Billina, who nearly ate the grasshopper before realizing it was a transformation.
Returns to the Emerald City in triumph, makes Dorothy a Princess of Oz, and promotes the private Omby Amby to Captain-General.
Rules the kings of the Munchkins, Winkies, Quadlings and Gillikins and lives in the Emerald City at the center of Oz.
Receives the Nome King's magic belt from Dorothy and agrees to watch her weekly in the magic picture and wish her back to Oz when signalled.

known_relations_book1.Dorothy: The Kansas girl she rescues and befriends; the two become devoted to each other.
known_relations_book1.Nome King: Her adversary — she demands the prisoners and is entrapped by him into a grasshopper.
known_relations_book1.Scarecrow: Her trusted adviser, who rides behind her chariot on the Sawhorse.
known_relations_book1.Tin Woodman: Her follower and commander of her army, transformed by the Nome King and later recovered.
known_relations_book1.Glinda: The friendly sorceress who gives her the magic carpet and later advises about the belt.
known_relations_book1.Billina: The yellow hen who breaks the Nome King's enchantment and restores her from a grasshopper.
known_relations_book1.Queen of Ev: The queen she crosses the desert to liberate, greeted as one princess greets another.
